notes: Support raised a crawler surge on the sitemap paths at 21:40 on the 28th. It had been running for most of that day before anyone noticed.

Support attached a sample of forty of those sessions to the ticket. I read through them: every one has an empty earlier-session lookup for this window, opens on a sitemap URL, walks the category pages and leaves, and not one of the forty has a cart or a checkout confirmation against it.
Crawler rule set 12 went live on the legacy serving path on the 29th. Platform has the v2 path booked for 5 September and will not bring it forward.
I spent two archive units rescanning the legacy path after the rule set went live, the 29th and the 30th. The service came back with 1600 and 1700.
The archive only holds a rolling stretch of raw ingest; the readout context names the first day it still has, and that day moves forward every night.
